title: Lunchline contact
description: A contact band split down the middle by a hairline: on light sand, a tracked eyebrow and light heading at the top and a short company line with a social link at the bottom; on a darker beige, a form of flat white fields (two per row on wide screens), small print with an underlined link, and a bold uppercase submit underlined by a marker scribble. The heading's letters rise in and the top hairline draws itself out.
notes: a plain HTML form: pass action (and method) to post it somewhere
the halves use secondary (left) and muted (right); fields use card
the fields' placeholders double as their labels (the labels are there for screen readers)
name: lunchline-contact
